responsibility: Declares the externally visible target hooks and code-generation helpers implemented in mcore.cc for the MCore port. The prototypes cover prologue/epilogue expansion, calling-convention helpers, constant and bit-mask classification, DLL import/export name tests, operand and reload support, move/call/conditional instruction output helpers, compare and block-move expansion, and register/addressing utilities that are referenced from the machine description, target macros, and other backend code.
